summary:
# IQA research & design (iteration 1)

> OFFLINE MODE: no live literature search or cloud model was used. Candidates and thresholds come from the local IQA workspace + the requirement report; all results are labelled with their real provenance (frozen pseudo-MOS benchmark).

## Business objective
轻量双输出 IQA 模型研发：输出 0-100 质量分与 blur/over_exp/under_exp/flare/white_balance 五类缺陷多标签；主指标 PLCC >= 0.85（真实 M
evidence_refs: IQA轻量双输出模型选型与数据集构建深度调研报告.docx

candidates.description: Frozen MobileCLIP2-S0 visual tower + L2-normalised features with a ridge MOS head; regularisation chosen on the official KonIQ train/val split, head refit on all dev rows. Reuses the exact deployable backbone already inside the ROM budget.
candidates.expected_gain: targets the real-MOS PLCC/SRCC gate directly; measured KonIQ test PLCC ~0.89
candidates.cost_estimate: ~1 run (~3-5 min GPU first time, cached)
failure_conditions: frozen features cap the frontier (~0.89); a LoRA finetune could go higher at more cost

hypotheses: Defect Macro-F1 is dominated by the blur, over_exp, under_exp classes; the frozen eval cannot measure white_balance (0 positives).
Weak classes carried over from feedback: none identified yet.
A frozen MobileCLIP2-S0 encoder with light multi-task heads reaches the ROM budget with headroom while beating the rule baseline on defect F1.
controls: identical frozen eval split and metric code for every candidate
ROM hard constraint checked on every exported model
compare against measure_threshold and the prior best

data_recipe.description: Frozen iqa_agent benchmark: 410 labelled dev rows (train/val, subject-disjoint) + 610-image frozen eval (labels held out of the method's data dir). Label-gap classes are filled offline: local_largemodel/qwen3.8-27b proposes candidate defect labels (scripts/iqa_annotate.py, prompt iqa-prelabel-v1) and every candidate goes through human review before it can enter a dataset version; classes with no measurable support receive severity-matched augmentation (see the data plan in the research report).
data_recipe.isolation: subject-group-disjoint train/val; eval labels never exposed to the method; augmentation never touches the frozen eval in the same protocol version

eval_protocol.notes: frozen metric code in algorithm_plugins/iqa/metrics.py (parity-checked against iqa_agent.tools.iqa_model.evaluate); ROM from fp16 params.
